title: Positive Einstein metric classification in dimension four
exact_target: Must every connected closed smooth Einstein four-manifold with strictly positive sectional curvature be isometric, after a positive metric scaling, to standard $S^{4}$, $CP^{2}$ with its Fubini–Study metric, or round $RP^{4}$? Nonorientable manifolds are included.
